metadata.description: Team Vibe Checker Question & Reason Database

personality.text: If you were a fruit, which would you be?
Are you a morning person or night owl?
Do you organize your bookshelf by color or by title?
Do you plan everything or just wing it?
Do you prefer working alone or in teams?
Do you laugh at your own jokes?
Window seat or aisle seat on planes?
Are you punctual or fashionably late?

workStyle.text: Deadline approach: plan ahead or panic last-minute?
Do you prefer email or Slack communication?
How many monitors do you use for work?
Do you take breaks during work?
Code review: constructive or brutal honesty?
Do you use dark mode or light mode?
Do you debug with print statements or a debugger?

lifeChoices.text: Pineapple on pizza: yes or no?
How do you eat cereal: milk first or cereal first?
Do you alphabetize your spice rack?
Do you eat the pizza crust?
Pick a movie genre: comedy, drama, or horror?
Do you rewatch your favorite shows?
Do you read the book or watch the movie first?
Hot sauce: maximum spice or mild?
Do you separate your laundry by color?

quirks.text: Do you talk to yourself while coding?
Do you have a lucky object?
Do you check under the bed before sleeping?
Do you read book reviews before reading?
Do you organize your browser tabs?
Do you sing in the shower?
Do you organize your Spotify playlists?
Do you label your kitchen containers?
Do you have a morning routine?

weirdStuff.text: If you were a superhero, would your power be visible or invisible?
Would you rather have the ability to fly or be invisible?
If you could teleport, would you use it for work?
Would you rather fight one horse-sized duck or 100 duck-sized horses?
If you could have any accent, which would it be?
Would you time travel to the past or future?
Do you think we're living in a simulation?

workEnvironment.text: Do you wear shoes while working from home?
How many coffee/tea breaks per day?
Would you work from a coffee shop?
Collaborate in silence or with background music?
